name: Hilary's Necklace
summary: On the docks at Lakeshire, Hilary loses the necklace her father gave her while fishing. Her friend Shawn asks travelers to retrieve it from Lake Everstill, where their parents forbid them to swim.

sections.title: A Day at the Docks
sections.body: Hilary and Shawn spend the day fishing along Lakeshire's docks, trying to enjoy an ordinary childhood amid the threats around the Redridge Mountains. Hilary drops her treasured necklace into Lake Everstill. After searching the piers and shore without finding it, Shawn asks travelers for help.

sections.title: Perils of Lake Everstill
sections.body: Hilary and Shawn's parents forbid them to swim in Lake Everstill. Aggressive murlocs and hungry threshedons lurk beneath the surface. The children cannot reach the necklace in the glinting mud at the lake bottom, so Shawn turns to travelers for help recovering the gift.

faq.answer: Hilary, a young girl in Lakeshire, lost the necklace her father gave her. It matters deeply to her because it was his gift.

faq.q: Why can't Shawn or Hilary swim down and get it themselves?
faq.answer: Their parents forbid them to swim in Lake Everstill because aggressive murlocs and predatory threshedons lurk beneath the surface.

faq.q: Where did the necklace end up?
faq.answer: The necklace slipped off the docks and settled into a mound of glinting mud on Lake Everstill's western lake bed.
Effsee is Hilary's pet kitten in Lakeshire. She keeps Hilary company and joins her in thanking travelers who recover the necklace.

faq.q: Who starts the request to find the necklace?
faq.answer: Shawn, Hilary's friend, was fishing with her on the docks. He asks travelers to help because he knows how much her father's gift means to her.

faq.q: Why does this task matter to Lakeshire?
faq.answer: Recovering a lost keepsake offers comfort and normalcy to Lakeshire's families, who struggle to live peacefully under constant threat.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, helping Lakeshire's beleaguered citizens with personal hardships shows your commitment to protecting everyday townsfolk as well as confronting larger threats.
